verdict.rationale: Granola documents some practical transcription facts: it captures computer audio rather than sending a bot, supports 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile, and labels speakers as "Me/Them" by default with optional speaker tags. It does not name the models it uses, make accuracy claims, or describe known limits. missing for 10: named transcription/ASR models, accuracy or word-error-rate claims, documented known limitations (accents, noise, crosstalk), independent or hands-on corroboration of transcript quality.
